items.title: George Pickens: Practices Friday
items.text:
Pickens (shoulder) was present at Friday's practice, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: Cleared for return in Week 7
items.text:
Judkins (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation and said he's "good to go" for Sunday's game against the Titans, Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Won't practice Friday, to be questionable
items.text:
Nacua (calf) won't practice Friday and will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Not at Friday's practice
items.text:
Goedert (knee) was not seen at Friday's portion of practice open to the media, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Will miss Sunday's game
items.text:
Rice (hamstring) will be out for Sunday's game at Seattle, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
